name: mdf
description: Midnight Forge ships MDF init/task skills plus auto-workflow, quick-workflow-pr, and PR-capable delivery workflows.

interface.shortDescription: MDF init/task skills and agent-skills workflows for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Midnight Forge exposes local MDF initialization and task management plus vendored agent-skills workflows. Use auto-workflow for repeated local implementation through review, simplification, and commit; use quick-workflow-pr for explicit small changes that skip spec and plan while reusing canonical build, review, and GitHub PR delivery; use auto-workflow-pr for the full ship, push, and GitHub PR workflow.
defaultPrompt: Use init before MDF workflows, use the use-mdf skill to choose the right MDF workflow, run auto-workflow for local implementation, quick-workflow-pr for small changes that intentionally skip spec and plan, or auto-workflow-pr for final PR delivery.
